uninterpreted_option.comment: The parser stores options it doesn't recognize here. See above.

declaration.comment:
go/protobuf-stripping-extension-declarations
Like Metadata, but we use a repeated field to hold all extension
declarations. This should avoid the size increases of transforming a large
extension range into small ranges in generated binaries.

verification.comment:
The verification state of the range.
TODO(b/278783756): flip the default to DECLARATION once all empty ranges
are marked as UNVERIFIED.

number.comment: The extension number declared within the extension range.

full_name.comment:
The fully-qualified name of the extension field. There must be a leading
dot in front of the full name.

type.comment:
The fully-qualified type name of the extension field. Unlike
Metadata.type, Declaration.type must have a leading dot for messages
and enums.

reserved.comment:
If true, indicates that the number is reserved in the extension range,
and any extension field with the number will fail to compile. Set this
when a declared extension field is deleted.

repeated.comment:
If true, indicates that the extension must be defined as repeated.
Otherwise the extension must be defined as optional.

VerificationState.comment: The verification state of the extension range.

comments.DECLARATION: All the extensions of the range must be declared.
